label: Work
classifier_hint: Describe, in one or two sentences, what belongs in this area. This text is fed verbatim to the triage model and is the single biggest lever on classification quality.

label: Home
classifier_hint: The house and household: utilities, repairs, purchases, errands.

label: Unsorted
classifier_hint: Use when the capture does not clearly belong to any other area, or is too ambiguous to place confidently. Never force a guess — route here instead.

label: Old area
classifier_hint: An area you no longer use. Keep the row (older captures and actions reference it) but retire it: triage stops offering it and the app stops listing it. The bridge (docs/arc-spec-bridge.md) routes work by these ids, so they should match your vault's domains.
